summary: 围绕 KelpDAO 事件，Arbitrum 安全委员会冻结了攻击者的 ETH。samczsun 称这是受害者的大日子；dankrad 认为安全委员会出手阻止朝鲜是好事，关键是未来的边界在哪里；binji_x 则感慨只能靠可信的人为干预来阻止。RogerPodacter 两次更新 EIP-8182（私密 ETH 与 ERC-20 转账），均当天提交并合并。derekchiang 提交 frame 交易规范验证器 ERC。

state tiering by write age EIP merged
summary_en: In the KelpDAO aftermath, the Arbitrum security council froze the exploiter's ETH. samczsun called it a huge day for victims; dankrad said it was great the council stopped North Korea and the question is where the line will be; binji_x lamented that trusted human intervention was the only way to stop it. RogerPodacter updated EIP-8182 (private ETH and ERC-20 transfers) twice, each submitted and merged the same day. derekchiang submitted an ERC for canonical frame transaction verifiers.
